definitions.explanation: An expensive car from a prestige maker or a top model line, often seen as a status symbol.

examples.japanese: {高級車|こうきゅうしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}っている→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高級車|こうきゅうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{三台|さんだい}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: He owns no fewer than three luxury cars.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見慣|みな}れない→見慣れる：07953_minareru⟧{高級車|こうきゅうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{停|と}まって⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An unfamiliar luxury car was parked in front of the station, and the neighbors were gossiping about it.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高級車|こうきゅうしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to drive (ride in) a luxury car
- {高級車|こうきゅうしゃ}⟦ブランド→ブランド：05221_burando⟧: luxury car brand
- ⟦{国産|こくさん}→国産：12017_kokusan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{高級車|こうきゅうしゃ}: a Japanese-made luxury car

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{外車|がいしゃ}→外車：19013_gaisha⟧: an imported car; in Japan the word itself often suggests an expensive European car
- ⟦{軽自動車|けいじどうしゃ}→軽自動車：14298_keijidousha⟧: a kei car, the small, cheap end of the market
